cards.title: Connecting classes
intro: By linking classes, you allow clients to use products and credits in multiple classes of this programme. In linked classes, the client can see the full offer and sessions across linked 1-to-1 classes. This will, for example, allow the client to use one season ticket in several classes within the programme.
